purpose: Owns AC-SEND-10 (meta-event send fails closed): centralizes the fail-closed behavior for producing the forwardable signed inner kind-0 envelope (serialiseProfileUpdate) so a locked/absent signer NEVER results in an emitted meta-event or a local action implying success, with surfacing split by call-site nature — interactive (visible i18n error) vs background/relay (dev-log only, relies on the pre-existing profile-request retry machinery). Also confirms (does not re-implement) that the profile-request bind (spec.md Solution §8) already holds: a mismatched-sender kind-30 rumor is dropped at S1's dispatcher choke point before ANY handler (including profileRequestHandler.ts) runs — no separate handler-level check exists or is needed for this story.

public_api.name: signAndSendProfileBackground
public_api.signature: (args: { signer: EventSigner | null; profile: UserProfile; sendRumor: (payload: string) => Promise<void>; logLabel: string }) => Promise<{ sent: boolean }>
public_api.description: Exported from MarmotContext.tsx (module-scope pure/DI function, mirrors the fireAutoCommit / applyPairingAdmissionDigest precedent). Attempts serialiseProfileUpdate(profile, signer); on a null signer or a thrown signature, `sendRumor` is NEVER invoked (no meta-event, no local action) and the failure is dev-logged only via console.warn. On success, calls the caller-bound `sendRumor(payload)` exactly once and returns { sent: true }. This is THE single implementation every background/relay profile-send call site funnels through (onHistorySynced auto-publish, sendSelfProfile's AC-030 self-reply, createGroup's welcome broadcast, inviteByNpub's post-invite re-send).

public_api.name: signProfileForInteractiveSend
public_api.signature: (profile: UserProfile, signer: EventSigner | null, errorMessage: string, onSignFailed: (message: string) => void) => Promise<string | null>
public_api.description: Exported from MarmotContext.tsx. The interactive twin of signAndSendProfileBackground: on a null signer or a thrown signature, invokes `onSignFailed(errorMessage)` (wired to a Chakra toast by publishProfileUpdate) and returns null — the caller MUST treat null as 'stop, nothing was emitted, nothing was actioned locally' and must not enter any per-group send loop. On success returns the signed payload. The signer check runs before any caller-side local action (VQ-S8-006).

profile_request_bind_confirmation.claim: spec.md Solution §8 / architecture.md's per-type actor-rules table row 'profile_request (30-req) | choke-point drop only (target-driven auto-reply) | no separate handler logic' already holds and required NO code change this story.
profile_request_bind_confirmation.evidence: applicationRumorDispatcher.ts's subscribe() listener resolves `sender` and compares `sender.pubkey !== rumor.pubkey` (drop + dev-log, no markSeen, no fan-out) BEFORE the `handlers.filter((h) => h.kind === rumor.kind)` fan-out loop that would otherwise route to profileRequestHandler.ts (kind 30). This is unconditional across all kinds, including 30 — profileRequestHandler.ts's own handle() body has no sender-comparison logic of its own (confirmed by reading the file: it only branches on reqPayload.targetPubkey === ctx.selfPubkeyHex, never on `sender`), which is correct per the architecture table: the auto-reply is target-driven (who is the request FOR), not sender-authorization-driven (who SENT the request) — that authorization already happened at the choke point.
